scopeNote: Covers code cases and permits handled by the City of Fort Worth. Other Tarrant County cities (Arlington, Grapevine, Keller and the rest) and unincorporated county areas keep their own records.

violations.coverage: Fort Worth Code Compliance violations, about 84,000 rows from 2007 to present, one row per violation, so a case with several violations appears more than once.

permits.coverage: Fort Worth development permits, about 1.6 million records filed 2001 to present. Trade permits (electrical, mechanical, plumbing, backflow) are included alongside building permits. The street is split across columns: with a house number, '8653 Funtier Ct' is matched as 8653 on Addr_No and 'Funtier' on Street_Name (one leading direction and one common street type are dropped). Without a house number the name alone gets the same trimming, so 'Funtier Ct' is matched as 'Funtier' on Street_Name.

source.name: City of Fort Worth Open Data
source.currentRecordsNote: Code Compliance violations and Development Services permits are published as ArcGIS tables. The permits table's one-line address column is empty, so the search matches the street name and house number columns.
